sum_digits[i][j] = digit[i][j] + sum_digits[i+1][j] + sum_digits[i][j+1] - sum_digits[i+1][j+1]

import sys

MOD = None

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.readline
    n = int(input())
    grid = [input().strip() for _ in range(n)]

    # dp_sum[i][j]: sum of digit-values of all reachable starting cells X
    #               such that X can reach cell (i, j), including itself.
    # For an obstacle, value is irrelevant.
    dp = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]

    ans = 0

    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            c = grid[i][j]
            if c == '#':
                continue

            v = ord(c) - ord('0')

            top = dp[i - 1][j] if i > 0 and grid[i - 1][j] != '#' else 0
            left = dp[i][j - 1] if j > 0 and grid[i][j - 1] != '#' else 0
            diag = dp[i - 1][j - 1] if i > 0 and j > 0 and grid[i - 1][j - 1] != '#' else 0

            # Inclusion-exclusion:
            # reachable starts to current cell are those reaching top or left, plus itself.
            # Starts reaching both top and left are exactly those reaching diag.
            dp[i][j] = top + left - diag + v

            # Sum over X != current of digit[X] * digit[current]
            ans += v * (dp[i][j] - v)

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
